violations.description: The background is a solid color (#005D8D) instead of a linear gradient from #00122C to #006A97.
A background band (el_disclaimer_band) is present behind the disclaimer, but the rule states only text on the gradient.
A node network motif (el_motif_node_network) is present in the background, but brand rules specify no motifs for this style.
The logo (el_logo) is placed top-left, but for a square format, it should be horizontally centered at the top.
The headline (el_headline) is entirely white, but brand rules mandate a two-color split (yellow for the key claim, white for the rest).
The headline font size (98px) is larger than the estimated 70-80px for a square format.
The disclaimer font size (20px) is smaller than the recommended range of 22-32px for similar formats.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) is placed at the very bottom of the canvas, below the CTA, instead of between the headline and the CTA.
The CTA button (el_cta) is left-aligned (x=50) instead of horizontally centered for a square format.
The CTA button (el_cta) includes a chevron, but the pill-button style (appropriate for square) should not have one.
The banner lacks a device mockup, which is the primary visual element for variety according to the brand rules for this style.
The background (el_background) is a solid color (#005D8D) instead of a linear gradient from #00122C to #006A97 as specified in the brand rules.
A decorative band (el_disclaimer_band) is present behind the disclaimer text, but the brand rules state that the disclaimer should be just text on the gradient, with no background rectangle.
The background color of the disclaimer band (el_disclaimer_band) is #7BA3BD, which is not part of the approved brand color palette.
A node network motif (el_motif_node_network) is present in the background, but brand rules state that no motifs should be used, with visual variety coming from the device mockup.
The MEXEM logo (el_logo) is placed in the top-left corner, but for a square format, it should be centered horizontally at the top of the canvas.
The headline (el_headline) is entirely white, but brand rules mandate a two-color split where the first part (key claim) is yellow and the rest is white.
The disclaimer font size (el_disclaimer is 18px) is too small. For a square format (extrapolated from leaderboard), it should be ~22-26px.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) is placed at the very bottom of the canvas, below the CTA. Brand rules state it must be placed between the headline block and the CTA.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) is center-aligned. For a square format (extrapolated from leaderboard), it should be left-aligned.
The CTA (el_cta) is a pill-shaped button, but for a square format (extrapolated from leaderboard), it should be a full-width band anchored to the bottom edge of the canvas.
The CTA background color (el_cta is white) is incorrect. For a square format (extrapolated from leaderboard), it should be yellow (#F5C518).
The CTA (el_cta) has rounded corners (pill shape). For a square format (extrapolated from leaderboard), the CTA band should have sharp corners (border-radius: 0).
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) has a background band (el_disclaimer_band) which is not allowed. It should be text directly on the gradient.
The background (el_background) is a solid color (#005D8D) instead of a linear gradient from #00122C to #006A97.
A node network motif (el_motif_node_network) is present, but decorative motifs are not allowed for this banner style.
The logo (el_logo) width (787px) is larger than the specified ~700px for portrait format.
The headline (el_headline) is entirely white, but it must have a two-color split: the first part in yellow and the rest in white.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) font size (22px) is smaller than the recommended 28-32px for portrait format.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) is placed below the CTA (el_cta) at the very bottom of the canvas, but it should be placed between the headline and the CTA.
The CTA (el_cta) width (938px) is too wide for portrait format; it should be ~60% of the canvas width.
The headline (el_headline) is positioned higher (y=328) than the typical layout for portrait banners, which usually starts around y=400.
The background (el_background) is a solid color (#002B4B) instead of a linear gradient from #00122C to #006A97.
A motif (el_motif_abstract_bars) is present in the background, but the brand rules state 'No motif' for general decorative elements.
For square banners, the logo (el_logo) should be centered horizontally at the top, but it is placed top-left.
The headline (el_headline) is entirely white, but it should always have a two-color split: the first part in yellow and the rest in white.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) is placed below the CTA, but it should always be between the headline block and the CTA.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) has a background band (el_disclaimer_band) behind it, but the rules state 'No legal-band rectangle behind it. Just text on the gradient'.
The disclaimer (el_disclaimer) font size is 20px, which is smaller than the recommended range of 22-26px for leaderboard and 28-32px for portrait, impacting legibility.
The banner is missing a device mockup, which is expected as the primary visual element for visual variety. Instead, a large red accent shape is present.
The background ('el_background') is a solid color (#002B4B) instead of a linear gradient from #00122C to #006A97.

A decorative motif ('el_motif_abstract_bars') is present, but the brand rules state 'No motif' for general decorative elements, with the exception of a very subtle candlestick texture under a phone mockup, which is not the case here.
The logo ('el_logo') width is 787px, which is larger than the recommended ~700px for portrait banners.
The logo ('el_logo') is positioned at y=50, which is higher than the recommended ~y=140 for the logo block in portrait banners.
The headline ('el_headline') is entirely white. It must be split into two colors: the first part in yellow (#F5C518) and the rest in white (#FFFFFF).
The headline ('el_headline') font size is 86px, which is smaller than the recommended ~120–160px for portrait banners.
The headline ('el_headline') is positioned at y=328, which is higher than the recommended ~y=400 for portrait banners.
The disclaimer ('el_disclaimer') font size is 22px, which is smaller than the recommended ~28–32px for portrait banners.
The disclaimer ('el_disclaimer') is placed at the very bottom of the banner, below the CTA. It should be placed between the headline block and the CTA.
The disclaimer ('el_disclaimer') has a background band ('el_disclaimer_band') behind it. The rules state it should be just text on the gradient, with no legal-band rectangle.
The CTA text ('el_cta') is 'EXPLORE YOUR OPTIONS →', but the recommended text for portrait banners is 'START INVESTING'.
The CTA ('el_cta') width is 938px (86.85% of canvas width), which is much wider than the recommended ~60% for portrait banners.
The CTA ('el_cta') includes a chevron ('→'), but the portrait CTA should not have a chevron.
The CTA ('el_cta') is positioned at y=940, which is higher than the recommended ~y=1180 for portrait banners.
The banner is missing the required device mockup in the visual region at the bottom of the canvas.
